source_message:
feat(g03): emergency stop Marble UI + production deploy (G-03 complete)

admin panel (emergency_panel.html):
  - Dark-theme HTML/CSS/JS — zero external dependencies
  - Live status polling every 15s
  - Activate form: operator_id + reason (EU AI Act Art. 14)
  - Resume form: mlro_id + resume_reason (MLRO authority gate)
  - Visual: green dot (running) / red pulsing (SUSPENDED)
  - URL: GET /compliance/admin/emergency (served by FastAPI)

api.py:
  - Added HTMLResponse import
  - New endpoint GET /compliance/admin/emergency → serves panel

marble_emergency_workflow.json:
  - n8n workflow spec for Marble webhook → compliance API routing
  - Handles: activate / resume / status actions
  - Webhook: POST /webhook/marble-emergency (n8n :5678)

scripts/deploy-emergency-stop.sh:
  - Full 6-step production deploy on GMKtec
  - Creates /data/banxe/data/ dirs, checks Redis, restarts API
  - Smoke test: activate → 503 → resume → 200 (I-23 verification)

test_emergency_stop.py:
  - Fixed sys.modules cleanup after module teardown
  - Prevents mock contamination of other test files (order-independent)

Tests: 74/74 pass in both orderings

Closes: GAP-REGISTER G-03 (pending deploy)
Invariants: I-23 (stop check before decision), I-24 (audit trail)
